name: PHYSKIT-CAPABILITY-DEVELOPMENT
description: Reusable human-gated workflow for bounded PhysKit capability development without selecting a capability.

ownership_model.parent_coordinator: bounded intake, activation, task and active-state coordination, exact ownership assignment, correction classification and routing, parent verification, and human checkpoint presentation
ownership_model.physkit-capability-architect: exact task-owned capability contract and architecture paths only
ownership_model.physkit-implementation: exact task-owned production paths under src/physkit only
ownership_model.physkit-verification: exact task-owned test paths under tests and separately justified evidence-summary paths only
ownership_model.physkit-notebook-documentation: exact task-owned notebook and user-facing documentation paths only
ownership_model.human: all protected scientific, numerical, API, pedagogical, evidence applicability, criteria, adequacy, validation, canonical-artifact, lifecycle, final-acceptance, and successor decisions

required: read and reconcile .pi/active-state.json as the sole runtime authority
verify active state and the active task explicitly instantiate this template ID for a human-authorized capability task
verify the role current stage and exact ownership are active in that task instance
read the human-accepted capability contract when it exists; initial contract drafting must verify that its authorized instance stage explicitly permits the contract to be absent
confirm exact task-owned and prohibited paths
inspect repository identity, starting revision, branch, remotes, and complete working-tree state without inspecting unrelated untracked contents
confirm stop conditions and successor authorization
startup_preflight.fail_closed_if: runtime authority or task-instance authority is missing, stale, contradictory, ambiguous, inactive, does not instantiate this template ID, or does not activate the role current stage and exact work; template availability alone is never activation
startup_preflight.reviewer_additional_check: verify every writer recorded successful startup preflight before reviewing
startup_preflight.template_rule: Do not fail merely because the immutable reusable template has no mutable active-task status; fail when active state and the active task lack an active authorized instance.

artifact_path_selection.decision_owner: human through the accepted capability contract
artifact_path_selection.axis_independence_rule: No decision on reusable_library_interface determines notebook_artifact, and no notebook decision determines reusable library applicability.

C.name: library plus approved notebook exception
C.alternative_requirement: demonstrate or explain accepted library behavior to the extent required by the accepted contract

artifact_path_selection.path_consistency_rule: The selected path must exactly match the two separately accepted axis values.
artifact_path_selection.skip_rule: Every skipped stage must cite its axis-specific accepted contract clause and human-approved rationale; one axis rationale cannot satisfy the other, and missing work is neither an exception nor Not applicable.

fields_per_class: exact artifact or evidence-summary path when written
observed outcome: passed, failed, indeterminate, or not-run
whether unresolved status blocks final handoff
evidence_disposition_contract.candidate_rule: A bounded Candidate outcome may retain required-incomplete or deferred evidence only with explicit claim limits and an explicit blocking/nonblocking final-handoff disposition accepted by a human.
evidence_disposition_contract.authority_rule: Agents collect and assess evidence; only humans accept applicability, criteria, adequacy, physical validation, and pedagogical validation.
evidence_disposition_contract.anti_collapse_rule: Failed, deferred, missing, difficult, unavailable, and unreviewed evidence are not Not applicable and are not satisfied evidence.
evidence_disposition_contract.failure_recording_rule: A required evidence obligation with observed outcome failed remains required-incomplete and must also record observed outcome failed, method, provenance, limitations, claim boundary, and blocking disposition; failure must never be hidden as mere absence.

concurrency_rules.allowed: read-only inspection; deterministic nonmutating checks; or writers with exact nonoverlapping paths and an explicit accepted integration seam
concurrency_rules.forbidden: overlapping writers, verification against partial source, library reconstruction before accepted API implementation, or correction concurrent with affected review
concurrency_rules.explicit_notebook_exception: Explicit notebook construction may run concurrently with implementation only after explicit human contract acceptance and completed ownership and implementation planning, when the accepted plan records independence from unaccepted implementation behavior and exact paths do not overlap.

records: complete working-tree state without inspecting unrelated untracked contents

chain.required_decision: Human identifies one bounded capability, learner purpose, intended use, initial exclusions, and authority to draft a contract.

must_define: exactly one artifact path A, B, C, or D
both independent applicability axes and any required human rationales

chain.result_required: exact nonoverlapping path ownership, separately accepted library/notebook axis values, selected consistent artifact path, conditional applicability and axis-specific skip clauses, all five evidence-class dispositions and paths, dependencies, concurrency independence, checks, handoffs, exclusions, correction routing, correction-cycle count and stop rules

chain.content: explicit physical, mathematical, numerical, code, and direct-verification construction without hiding the target behind PhysKit

chain.applicable_when: accepted-artifact-path:A only; both reusable_library_interface and notebook_artifact are required
chain.content: reconstruct the shared baseline with the accepted PhysKit API and explicitly compare it with Stage 7

Path A: exploration and API-consistent user documentation; Path B: appropriate exploration/documentation without library claims; Path C: API-consistent user documentation; Path D: skipped only under both separate accepted omission clauses.

mode_by_path.B: appropriate notebook exploration and documentation without a reusable API claim
mode_by_path.C: API-consistent user documentation for the implemented accepted library behavior

chain.content: Human-approved adequate alternative pedagogical representation with notebook-exception rationale and claim limits; for Path C it demonstrates or explains accepted library behavior to the contract-required extent; Path D additionally records the separate accepted library-omission rationale.

chain.applicable_when: always as a disposition-and-assessment stage; each class records both obligation state and observed outcome, including completed/passed, incomplete/failed, deferred, unresolved-blocking, or Not applicable only with human-accepted rationale
chain.must_report: all five distinct evidence dispositions, including incomplete or deferred evidence, claim limits, reviewers, and final-handoff blocking status; the stage itself may not be skipped
chain.responsible_roles: accepted five-class evidence matrix; each producer writes only exact assigned paths and reviewers remain read-only

chain.rule: Classify before any correction; final human acceptance cannot retroactively replace a required contract-reacceptance gate.

chain.scope_rule: each writer remains within unchanged exact ownership; no concurrent overlapping corrections

chain.result_required: recompute exact ownership, selected artifact path, all evidence dispositions, dependencies, invalidated work replay, and stop rules before returning to applicable Stage 6-12 work

chain.rule: replay every affected deterministic and evidence-producing check without changing accepted criteria

chain.route_precedence: any finding at or above the cycle limit routes to human escalation before finding-type routing
chain.bounded_loop: maximum one automatic ordinary correction/replay/re-review cycle; record count; no unlimited loop

chain.condition: material protected decision, or any new or unresolved finding when correction_cycle_count>=1
chain.scope_rule: No outcome silently widens scope; new protected or expanded work requires explicit human authorization.

chain.result: evidence and artifact package ready for human disposition; no evidence, validation, canonical, lifecycle, or support conclusion is accepted by the parent

chain.lifecycle_promotion: outside this workflow unless independently human-authorized

template_semantics.instantiation_rule: A human-authorized active task instantiates this template by recording the template ID, task-instance identity, active stage, and exact ownership in active state and the active task record.
template_semantics.mutation_rule: Capability activation and task-instance progress update active state and the task record; they do not mutate this reusable template into a current-state record.

parent_verification_may_establish: every required evidence class has a truthful recorded result
applicability and non-applicability rationales trace to the accepted contract
required methods, references, criteria, provenance, paths, reviewers, results, limitations, and claim boundaries are present
incomplete, deferred, failed, and unresolved evidence is labeled truthfully
no evidence result contradicts its accepted blocking rule
every applicable deterministic check and independent review completed
no unresolved material integration finding remains
the package is ready for human disposition
evidence_readiness_authority.contract_acceptance_rule: Earlier contract acceptance accepts obligations and blocking rules, not later evidence results or adequacy.
evidence_readiness_authority.blocking_violation_route: Any incomplete, deferred, failed, or unresolved result that violates its accepted blocking rule routes to correction_classification or human_escalation before parent_verification.
